Centific's MedMosaic: new AI benchmark reveals gaps in medical audio.

7h ago · 0:00 listen · Source: TipRanks

Summary.

Centific's AI Research team has launched a new benchmark called MedMosaic. This tool evaluates how well advanced AI models understand medical audio. Here's the thing: They tested 13 top audio and multimodal systems. These systems were evaluated on over 46,000 clinically validated question-answer pairs. These pairs covered tasks like heart, lung, cough, and speech-based reasoning. The results are sobering. The best-performing model only achieved 68% accuracy. This highlights significant gaps in performance. Centific suggests traditional AI benchmarks might miss these deficiencies. This means more rigorous, practice-oriented evaluations with clinically grounded data are crucial for reliable healthcare AI. What's interesting is MedMosaic could boost Centific's standing in healthcare AI evaluation. If adopted, it could create new revenue opportunities for the company through advisory, data, or tooling services. Centific also plans to present these findings at the ICML 2026 conference. This participation could help them build relationships with researchers, customers, and partners, supporting future development in healthcare AI. This matters because it points to the ongoing need for more accurate and reliable AI in critical healthcare applications.

This is an AI-generated audio summary. Always check the original source for complete reporting.

Centific advances its Data Marketplace with enhanced governance, automation, and enterprise onboarding capabilities.

Table of contents

REDMOND, WA - April 9, 2026 - Centific, a global leader in AI data services and solutions, today announced a major update to the Centific Data Marketplace (data.centific.com), its central platform for discovering, governing, and provisioning datasets across text, image, audio, video, tabular, and multimodal formats. The release significantly expands the platform's automation capabilities, enterprise controls, and integration with Data Canvas - Centific's annotation operating system for physical AI and robotics.

The Centific Data Marketplace brings together curated, synthetic, and agency-provided datasets, streamlines data requests, and enforces governance so enterprise AI teams can source and act on the right data with minimal friction. This release reflects Centific's continued investment in making high-quality AI training data more accessible, auditable, and operationally seamless for customers worldwide.

What's new in this release.

Catalog & discovery

Curated categories and featured datasets accelerate use-case-driven discovery. A new Partner Program page serves as a dedicated entry point for prospective data partners.

Automated project creation

Data Marketplace requests can now trigger automated Data Canvas project creation, with core configuration and tenant linkage handled directly by the platform - eliminating manual handoffs.

Cloud storage ingestion

Enhancement requests can now target AWS S3, GCP, and Azure buckets for Procured and Bring Your Own Data (BYOD) datasets, enabling consistent ingestion from external cloud environments.

Granular dataset selection

Customers configuring Enhancement Requests can now choose to enhance an entire dataset or target specific files and folders, guided by a redesigned selection UI aligned to Data Canvas modality terminology.

Admin pricing controls

Internal Centific users can now export the full Data Catalog directly from the Profile dropdown menu, supporting faster internal dataset audits and reporting workflows.

Catalog export

Administrators can now manage key dataset access transitions - including Free to Paid, Available on Request to Request a Quote, and Public to Private - through dedicated, validated flows that reduce misconfiguration.

This release is about removing the friction between data discovery and data activation. When a customer can go from identifying the right dataset to triggering an annotation pipeline in a single workflow, that changes the economics of AI development."

- Adam Hagestedt, Head of Product

Deeper integration between Data Marketplace and Data Canvas.

A central theme of this release is the tightening alignment between the Centific Data Marketplace and Data Canvas, Centific's Annotation Operating System for physical AI, robotics, and autonomous systems. Automated project creation and cloud storage ingestion from marketplace requests reduce the manual setup and configuration drift that previously required coordination across teams. Enhancement workflows now support BYOD cloud storages, making it easier to bring external data into the Centific ecosystem for annotation and processing at scale.

Looking ahead.

Centific's product roadmap includes several additional enhancements planned for upcoming releases:

* Real-time Data Canvas task status tracking visible directly from the Data Marketplace request table, giving customers end-to-end transparency into annotation progress without manual check-ins.
* Bulk dataset metadata editing from the Admin UI, enabling administrators to update catalog entries at scale in a single action.
* An agency catalog browsing experience with ratings and reviews, allowing sales and internal users to evaluate and provide feedback on data supply partners.
* A streamlined landing page experience that routes all users directly to the Data Catalog upon visiting data.centific.com.

Availability.

The Centific Data Marketplace is available now at data.centific.com.

Are your ready to get.

AI solutions delivered?

Connect data, models, and people - in one enterprise-ready platform.

Centific launches verityai SLiM, a next- generation agentic AI platform for global enterprises powered by NVIDIA.

Table of contents

SANTA CLARA, CA - March 17, 2026 - Centific, the leading AI Data Foundry, today announced the launch of VerityAITM SLiM, a next-generation agentic AI platform designed to help the public sector build, deploy, and scale AI applications across diverse global markets. The solution is built on NVIDIA's industry-leading hardware and software stack with Centific's deep expertise in multilingual, multimodal AI solutions, delivering a powerful platform for organizations ready to unlock the full potential of agentic AI. VerityAITM SLiM is engineered for rapid deployment, leveraging NVIDIA DGX Spark small form factor to help customers realize value in days rather than weeks or months.

The platform's AI agents are developed through Centific's AI Data Foundry (AIDF), which streamlines the development and deployment of agentic AI models through a user-friendly interface for creating and managing complex AI workflows. Its agentic AI lifecycle management capabilities are designed to accelerate time-to-market, reduce costs, and improve accuracy across the enterprise. According to internal benchmarks, organizations using VerityAITM SLiM have achieved up to 40% faster deployment cycles and a 30% reduction in operational errors compared to traditional approaches.

The platform operates through a comprehensive five-layer architecture. At its foundation, an infrastructure layer orchestrates multiple AI agents to execute complex tasks at scale. At the core sits a data and models layer supporting multimodal intelligence across more than 200 languages, enabling globally consistent performance in a multi-model environment. The agents and applications layer delivers pre-built intelligence so customers can realize value from day one. A distribution and interfaces layer integrates seamlessly into existing ecosystems through a broad partner network and integrations catalog. At the top, the customer layer serves enterprise and public-sector use cases with purpose-built agents designed for continuous improvement and measurable performance.

The platform offers several capabilities that distinguish it in the market. Businesses can begin with a single agent and expand their AI capabilities incrementally, minimizing upfront investment and risk while maximizing flexibility. Centific has curated an extensive library of pre-built agents spanning multiple business functions, each customizable for specific needs and deployable in days. Seamless integration with NVIDIA DGX Spark ensures optimal performance for both training and inference, enabling real-time decision-making and scalable growth.

Enterprise-grade compliance and security measures, including strict data privacy standards and built-in protections for sensitive information, make the platform prime for regulated industries, specifically public sector (FED and SLED), with healthcare and finance soon to follow.

Centific provides flexible engagement models designed to accelerate AI adoption and compress time-to-value. Through a structured two-month pilot, organizations can deploy production-grade infrastructure, test real-world use cases, and measure performance against defined ROI benchmarks. This hands-on engagement enables rapid validation of business impact before scaling to full deployment.

From there, organizations can graduate from VerityAITM SLiM to the full VerityAITM platform to multiply agents, augment existing assets, and deploy multi-model intelligence across the enterprise. The platform is available now, with new updates and enhancements rolled out regularly. To learn more or request a demo, visit centific.com/contact/book-a-demo.

"We believe AI delivers its greatest value when it's accessible, trusted, and grounded in human expertise," said Jagadish Garimella, VP and Head of Vision AI at Centific. "VerityAI(TM) SliM brings together advanced vision AI, human-in-the-loop intelligence, and scalable data infrastructure to help organizations deploy real-world AI solutions faster and more responsibly."

About centific.

Centific builds the data backbone behind modern AI systems. Centific Global Solutions, Inc. transform unstructured, real- world data into high-quality training intelligence, deploy agentic systems into production, and continuously evaluate performance in live environments. Its AI Data Foundry unifies data pipelines, expert human feedback, and model operations; so AI systems don't just launch, they improve with use.

Centific has helped train foundation models for the world's leading AI labs and supports enterprises building and adapting AI systems across industries, corporate functions and use cases. By connecting data, workflows, agents, evaluations, and expert human input, Centific enables continuous intelligence that compounds over time.

AI solutions delivered?

Centific and mimik partner to revolutionize AI-powered smart spaces with edge intelligence.

Centific, a Frontier AI data foundry platform company accelerating businesses' AI, and mimik, a leader in device-first continuum AI (DFC-AI), today announced a strategic partnership to introduce a groundbreaking AI-powered smart space solution. By integrating mimik's edge-native agentic runtime with Centific's AI Frontier AI data foundry platform, the collaboration brings an unprecedented level of real-time video intelligence, cost efficiency, and data privacy. This new paradigm unlocks proactive threat detection, behavioral insights, and scalable multi-camera AI processing without the traditional reliance on centralized cloud infrastructure.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250319791637/en/

mimik and Centific Enable Intelligent Video Analytics Across the AI Continuum

This partnership sets a new standard for edge-enabled AI in smart spaces.

The Centific-mimik solution pioneers an adaptive compute continuum, dynamically distributing AI workloads across edge devices, servers, and private cloud environments based on operational needs. This edge-first strategy eliminates cloud latency, reduces bandwidth overhead, and helps ensure AI-driven insights are context-aware, responsive, and secure within an organization's operational framework.

By leveraging mimik's scalable Open Edge (OE) platform alongside Centific's Frontier AI data foundry platform, the solution enables:

1. Federated AI processing across thousands of cameras with minimized data movement, optimizing edge execution.

2. Hybrid cloud integration to balance real-time decision-making at the edge with deeper analytics in secure cloud environments.

3. Autonomous AI agents leveraging multimodal video-linguistic AI models to provide proactive situational awareness.

4. Event-driven intelligence that enhances security and operational efficiency without dependency on constant connectivity.

Centific's Frontier AI data foundry platform elevates edge AI capabilities

Centific's Frontier AI data foundry platform plays a critical role in optimizing AI-driven video intelligence by:

Supporting 100s of use cases across industries with adaptable AI workflows and multi-model processing.

Leveraging 100+ pre-configured templates for rapid and efficient data extraction, localization, and contextualization.

Addressing data scarcity and privacy concerns by generating realistic synthetic datasets.

Helping to ensure data integrity with AI-driven validation and human-in-the- loop (HITL) oversight in quality assurance processes.

Enforcing safe AI practices with data privacy and compliance mechanisms on a global scale.

Providing enterprise-ready AI models that maximize performance and minimize costs through advancements in LLM fine-tuning and model optimization.

Centific's Frontier AI data foundry platform integrates seamlessly with mimik's edge intelligence platform, helping to ensure that AI models remain contextually adaptive, continuously refined, and efficiently deployed across diverse environments.

"At Centific," said Venkat Rangapuram, CEO of Centific, "we are committed to harnessing AI to create safer communities by making AI-driven solutions more accessible and affordable across all devices. Our collaboration with mimik reinforces this vision, bringing edge intelligence and real-time AI analytics to the forefront of public safety. By leveraging our Frontier AI data foundry platform-driven approach, we can help ensure that AI is not only scalable and cost-effective but also privacy-conscious and contextually adaptive. This marks a new era where organizations can deploy intelligent security solutions with heightened situational awareness while reducing infrastructure costs. Together, we are making AI work for everyone, everywhere."

"mimik's DFC-AI is transforming enterprise AI deployments," added Fay Arjomandi, Founder & CEO of mimik. "By harnessing the power of edge intelligence and federated AI, we enable organizations to execute agentic AI workloads efficiently, even in connectivity-limited environments."

This partnership is the future of AI-powered smart spaces

This partnership marks a pivotal shift in AI-driven security and public safety. By reducing reliance on cloud infrastructure and leveraging intelligent edge computing, organizations can now deploy scalable, privacy-conscious AI systems that operate with heightened situational awareness and reduced operational costs.

Centific launches Flow to revolutionize ai-powered localization at scale.

Centific, a leading AI data foundry platform company dedicated to accelerating AI adoption for businesses, has announced the launch of Flow, a groundbreaking AI-powered localization solution. Designed to help enterprises efficiently scale global content without compromising on quality, Flow combines advanced AI-driven workflows with human expertise, delivering up to a 31% reduction in localization costs and 77% faster turnaround times for key processes.

"Global businesses face a growing challenge: localizing content to resonate with diverse audiences in multiple markets while keeping costs in check and ensuring quality," said Venkat Rangapuram, CEO of Centific. "Flow helps companies break through these barriers, making localization faster, smarter, and more scalable than ever before. With AI and human expertise working in tandem, Flow empowers brands to maximize their impact on international audiences."

Streamlined Localization for Complex Needs

Flow empowers Centific's clients to achieve faster project delivery, cost savings, and the ability to rapidly scale their localization efforts to meet dynamic market demands. By leveraging both AI-driven automation and expert human oversight, Flow offers unmatched flexibility and efficiency.

Seamlessly integrating with existing content management systems (CMSs) and translation management systems (TMSs), Flow allows companies to enhance their localization strategies without requiring extensive technology overhauls. For those seeking a more independent approach, Flow can also function as a standalone solution.

What Sets Flow Apart

Flow stands out from other localization tools by delivering:

Faster Time to Market: Accelerates workflows, reducing processing times by up to 77%.

Cost Efficiency: Reduces localization expenses by up to 31% without sacrificing quality.

Seamless Integration: Easily integrates with existing CMS and TMS platforms for smooth adoption.

Scalability: Enables businesses to efficiently localize content in multiple languages, whether it's five or fifty.

Designed for ease of adoption, Flow features a user-friendly interface suitable for teams with varying technical expertise. Self-service onboarding tools further streamline project initiation, making it easier for businesses to harness the power of AI.

"Flow reflects the innovation and leadership that Centific has demonstrated time and again in the localization space," said Nimdzi Founder and Managing Director Tucker Carlson. "As businesses accelerate their localization efforts, they need an application like Flow to scale faster and more cost-effectively. Centific's expertise and Flow together are well suited for strategic localization leaders."

Centific's deep experience in localization has been instrumental in developing Flow, which empowers businesses to better connect with global audiences and maintain cultural relevance.

In a recent success story, Centific partnered with a global music streaming platform to scale localization for engagement-critical content, such as listener polls. By integrating AI-powered translation models with reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), Centific tripled the client's translation output while preserving cultural nuance and significantly reducing costs.

Flow is poised to redefine the future of localization, offering enterprises a powerful tool to stay competitive and connect meaningfully with audiences worldwide.

With the integration of NVIDIA's technologies, the platform offers tailored solutions, real-time data processing, and exceptional flexibility, enabling organizations to make smarter, more impactful decisions.
